GitHub - nickgildea/fast_dual_contouring: Fast (er) implementation of ...
This project contains a fast implementation of Dual Contouring -- or more accurately a simplified version of the algorithm. No octree is constructed, instead a regular grid is contoured (much like the leaf node grid in the original DC algorithm) & the resulting mesh is simplified using my mesh simplifier.
